Skin and soft-tissue necrosis is a rare but well-established adverse effect of coumarin anticoagu- lants.1-4 It is characterised by a localised, painful skin lesion, ini- tially erythematous or haemorrhagic in appearance, that be- comes bullous and eventually culminates in gangrenous necrosis.
